item.description:
## New Features
- Filter Records by conversation. The Tokens and cost columns show totals for all matching records. - See saved Codex conversation titles in the Records filter and in the details for a selected turn on Speed. - Spot logged Fast mode with a lightning icon in Overview, Records, and Speed. - Double-click the floating HUD to open the main window. - Speed charts group the last seven days by day and longer ranges by week.
## Fixes
- Keep filters on one row in narrow windows and show a short date format in Simplified Chinese Records. - Show one message when Speed or Overview has no results, with a way to adjust the range or filters. - Open cost and agent-support explanations on click, and use the same dropdown style throughout the app. - Fill missing Codex auto-review estimates using its existing fixed reference rate, including records marked Fast or Ultrafast. - Confirm the selected backup before restoring it and show save and backup results next to their controls.

## 新功能
- 明细支持按对话筛选，Tokens 和费用列上方显示全部匹配记录的合计。 - 在明细筛选和速度页的回合详情中查看 Codex 保存的会话标题。 - 总览、明细和速度页用闪电图标标记日志中记录的 Fast 模式。 - 双击悬浮 HUD 打开主窗口。 - 速度图在最近 7 天按日分组，范围更长时按周分组。
## 修复
- 窄窗口中筛选器保持单行，简体中文明细使用短日期。 - 速度和总览没有结果时，只显示一处提示，并提供调整日期或筛选的入口。 - 费用和 Agent 支持说明可以点击展开，应用内的下拉选择器统一样式。 - 沿用固定参考价补齐 Codex 自动审批费用估算，涵盖标记为 Fast 或 Ultrafast 的记录。 - 恢复账本前确认所选备份，保存和备份的结果显示在对应按钮旁。
